1
五星合聚
Conjunctions of the Five Planets.
2
天官書言同舍為合，於兩星、三星、四星、五星之合各有占，而以五星合為最吉，謂經度之同如合朔也。 茲就三星以上同宮同宿，及兩星以上同度者，著於篇。
The Treatise on the Celestial Offices holds that stars sharing a lodge are in conjunction; pairings, triplets, quadruplets, and full pentads each carry their own omens, yet the alignment of all five planets is deemed most auspicious—when their longitudes meet as at new moon. This chapter sets down cases in which three or more planets shared a palace and lodge, and those in which two or more shared the same degree.
3

Year 1, I/gengxu: Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus converged in Jiang for over twenty days. bingchen: Saturn and Venus shared 3 degrees of Bi. III/yisi: Saturn and Mercury shared 8 degrees of Bi.

IV/guiwei: Saturn and Mercury shared 7 degrees of Wei (Stomach). IX/wuxu: Jupiter, Mars, and Venus converged in Ximu; guimao: Mars and Venus shared 14 degrees of Wei (Tail). X/wuchen: Jupiter, Mars, and Venus converged in Xingji for ten days and 7 more; renshen: Jupiter and Venus shared 4 degrees of Ji. XII/renxu: shared 6 degrees of Dou; jisi: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury converged in Xingji; gengchen: Jupiter and Mercury shared 10 degrees of Dou.
153
六十年二月戊辰，木金同躔鬥二十一度。 三月戊辰，土火同躔昴四度。 四月乙酉，土火水聚於實沈旬有六日； 丁亥，土水同躔昴六度； 乙未，火水同躔畢十三度。 六月癸未，火金水聚於鶉首旬餘； 甲申，聚於井旬有八日； 己丑，火水同躔井二十二度； 癸卯，金水同躔井二十四度； 丙午，火金水聚於鶉火兩旬。 七月癸丑，聚於柳旬餘。 九月丙子，金水同躔氐十度。 十二月癸未，木金水聚於元枵浹旬； 癸巳，木水同躔女七度。
Year 60, II/wuchen: Jupiter and Venus shared 20 degrees of Dou. III/wuchen: Saturn and Mars shared 4 degrees of Mao. IV/yiyou: Saturn, Mars, and Mercury converged in Sishen for ten days and 6 more; dinghai: Saturn and Mercury shared 6 degrees of Mao; yiwei: Mars and Mercury shared 13 degrees of Bi (Net). VI/guiwei: Mars, Venus, and Mercury converged in Chunshou for over ten days; jiashen: They converged in Jing for ten days and 8 more; jichou: Mars and Mercury shared 20 degrees of Jing; guimao: Venus and Mercury shared 20 degrees of Jing; bingwu: Mars, Venus, and Mercury converged in Chunhuo for twenty days. VII/guichou: They converged in Liu for over ten days. IX/bingzi: Venus and Mercury shared 10 degrees of Di. XII/guiwei: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury converged in Yuanxiao for a full ten-day period; guisi: Jupiter and Mercury shared 7 degrees of Nü.
